result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible, mainly truncated restaurant names/cards in horizontal lists and a cut-off category chip, which hurt readability and polish.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is heavily clipped on the right edge, and the restaurant name reads as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis—text and imagery are cut off mid-word/mid-card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels give cards consistent peek width, and apply text overflow handling (ellipsis or two-line clamp) so names never truncate mid-character.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a partial pill on the far right, making the filter bar look unfinished or broken rather than clearly scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance (fade edge, padding, or snap) so cut-off chips read as intentional overflow.

issues.description: Restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' appears incomplete/cut off rather than gracefully abbreviated.
issues.suggestion: Use full name with ellipsis overflow, or shorten intentionally with a full accessible label.

issues.description: Bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is mid-cut at the screen edge while the section header remains fully visible, which can feel abrupt on first paint.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards aren’t flush-clipped under the nav, or ensure safe-area spacing.
